entity: City of Chicago Heights Park District
role: Local park district / early coordination meeting participant
stance_basis: Park District deferred judgment on non-significance finding pending verification of replacement scheme before concurring
summary: The City of Chicago Heights Park District participated in an early coordination meeting on December 16, 1974, regarding the Roosevelt School property and Section 4(f) land procedures. The Park District declined to immediately concur with the Superintendent of Schools' finding that the playfield was 'not significant to the recreational needs of the community,' instead deciding to first verify the replacement scheme with the School District and the City of Chicago Heights before reconsidering the matter. The Park District Board promised a response within 30 days, and the document notes that upon receipt of that response, the relevant page would be replaced with appropriate documentation.
complaint_summary: The City of Chicago Heights Park District, at a December 16, 1974 coordination meeting, declined to immediately concur with the finding of 'non-significance' for the Roosevelt School playfield, deciding instead to first contact the School District and the City of Chicago Heights to verify the replacement scheme before reconsidering the matter.
summary_quote: It was decided, at the meeting, that the Park District would contact the School District and the City of Chicago Heights to verify the replacement scheme; and then would again consider the matter of "non-significance".
